notes.title: 100 USD Fangame Competition!
notes.notes:
I'm hosting a 100 USD Kard Sens themed fangame competition! Any genre goes! Teams are allowed! 

If you're interested, head to the official discord server for rules and information! It starts in 2 days and you will have 2 weeks to make your game!

DISCORD: discord.gg/tR2W26x9YA

notes.title: Minor Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, my heartfelt thank you goes out to everyone who bought this game, I really really appreciate the support. This update changes the following:
